data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Graduates majoring in English can leverage their expertise in communication and language instruction to become literary writers, editors, translators, or speech coaches. They are also well-suited for roles such as proofreaders, news writers, and ESL/EFL teachers for international learners. Meanwhile, Mathematics majors can apply their strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to technical fields, pursuing careers as data analysts, statisticians, or researchers. They are also qualified for entry-level roles in the financial sector, such as auditing staff, payroll specialists, and bank tellers, with the potential to advance into high-level roles as mathematicians or auditors.

data.name: label2.Text
data.value: The Bachelor of Secondary Education (BSED) programs, majoring in English and Mathematics, are comprehensive four-year degrees dedicated to producing the next generation of highly competent and motivated educators. Both majors are rooted in a curriculum that bridges advanced theoretical insights with practical, technology-driven teaching applications. Whether mastering the nuances of English Language Arts or the complexities of mathematical pedagogy, students are trained to be critical thinkers and effective communicators who can address the evolving global needs of 21st-century learners while upholding the highest standards of professional ethics and leadership.
